headline: GAP Appoints Héctor Cortés to Lead $161 Million Kingston Airport Expansion
summary: Mexican airport operator Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico named Héctor Cortés CEO of subsidiary PACKAL to oversee a J$25.8 billion ($161 million) modernization project at Norman Manley International Airport in Jamaica.
why: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico operates 14 airports across Mexico and Jamaica under long-term concessions.

impacts.name: Grupo Aeroportuario del Pacífico
impacts.why: GAP appointed a new chief executive to manage its $161 million capital expenditure program at Kingston Airport.
